notes: ADR-063 Q4-DS4-RACE (#667) same-file native comparison (decision D2): ds4 c97964b serving the ds4 file that the hf2q arm of q5_cases/deepseek4-ds4file.json loads (sha256 ca22ae2f838e14077c22bc1c1417b71b45b5e5a3687bd96c2ac6e17fdb6261c0). The approval native_ds4 block declares artifact_relation same_as_hf2q (bound through case_sha256 and native_peer_ds4.campaign_identity; it is not a case variable, so --peer-var cannot change it). The arm label is 'ds4 c97964b (same ds4 file)'. Copy of native-ds4-deepseek4.json: DS4_DIR (the root's c97964b build tree with the file under gguf/), MODEL_SHA256, PORT, workload.id and the declaration differ; the different-artifact case stays unchanged for its own campaigns.

Q3 runs it only as a --native-comparison --peer-case (q3_campaign.py refuses --peer-unavailable-evidence: the same-file peer runs, Q4-DS4 Fit). Launch needs the native and the hf2q artifact sha256 both present and equal. The result is verdict.json native_peer, task makespan only, never a win and never the verdict of record: the weights are the same bytes, but prompts are not byte-identical (ds4 renders tool schemas first and its Think Max prefix differs).
MODEL_SHA256 verification: the section 6.1 T2 full-file digest receipt (/Users/robert/.local/state/hf2q/v0130/q4-ds4-race/t2-digest.json, not written yet).

Think Max control: the canonical request sends reasoning_effort=max, which ds4 honours only when the per-session context is >= 393216 (DS4_THINK_MAX_MIN_CONTEXT, ds4.c:424-427, 61096-61100) and otherwise silently renders normal thinking. --ctx is per session (each of the 4 sessions gets cfg.ctx_size, ds4_server.c:15993-16003), so NATIVE_DS4_CTX defaults to 393216 and the adapter refuses anything lower. The workload stays 262144 per slot: the client refuses any turn whose prompt plus 8192 output exceeds 262144. Memory implication: four 393216-token sessions; the startup line 'N resident sessions request at least X GiB ... or Y GiB when the model shares one prefill workspace' (ds4_server.c:15514-15527) is parsed and recorded by native_peer_ds4.readiness.

Parity flags: --batched-session 4 (four resident sessions, ds4_server.c:15695-15696); no --mtp/--dspark (session batching disables them anyway, ds4_server.c:16021-16024); no --kv-disk-dir, so the disk KV cache is off (ds4_server.c:16006-16009), matching hf2q DeepSeek disk_persistence=false; the --kv-cache-* knobs only tune that disk cache and keep their defaults; --power 100 is the default made explicit (ds4.c:60388); --tokens 8192 mirrors the peer's --predict 8192 and is proved by /v1/models top_provider.max_completion_tokens; exact DSML tool replay stays on (default).

--chdir {DS4_DIR}: ds4 reads its 26 Metal kernel sources from metal/*.metal relative to the working directory at startup (ds4_metal.m:4754-4823); q5 launches with cwd={OUT}, and child_env passes no DS4_METAL_*_SOURCE override (q5_case.PASSTHROUGH). The client pins the sha256 of every kernel source at c97964b.

--trace {OUT}/ds4-trace.txt records each request's think_mode, sampling, max_tokens and rendered prompt (trace_begin, ds4_server.c:11983-12036). q2_run_audit refuses a Pass unless every request ran think_mode max, greedy sampling, max_tokens 8192 and a rendered prompt beginning with BOS plus ds4's Think Max prefix. Trace writes are unbuffered per token piece (ds4_server.c:12039-12045, 16034).

Identity: DS4_BIN_SHA256 (the root's c97964b build) and MODEL_SHA256 are required inputs (download_model.sh pins no checksum for this file, artifact_identity 466-537). Readiness is GET /v1/models ('object' == 'list'), served only after the model and all four sessions exist (listen at ds4_server.c:16071-16088, after session creation at 15993-16003). The client then checks the binary sha256, the kernel sources, /v1/models (V4 Flash shape, context, 8192 output) and the startup log. Template parity is Unavailable: ds4 renders DSML in C, and its Think Max prefix is the hf2q 0731 template's 'high' tier text, not its 'max' tier text.
Run as a calibration (no --admission-receipt): a different binary from every hf2q calibration.
